lanes.summary: The diff implements the pre-push stamping mechanism correctly, fulfilling all requirements of PMAT-437. It successfully shifts the quality gates out of the SSH connection window to prevent timeouts. The `scripts/prepush_gates.sh` script correctly asserts a clean working tree using `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal`, comprehensively addressing the flaw highlighted in Round 5 by ensuring no uncommitted tracked changes or untracked files of any type (which could influence the build/tests) are present before stamping. The `.githooks/pre-push` hook accurately consumes standard input to read pushed SHAs, bypasses gates for branch deletions, skips gates for stamped commits, and falls back to running gates in-line for unstamped commits. The 4-line clippy fix from #438 is also included precisely as requested.

The diff for PMAT-437 satisfies all requirements and acceptance criteria without weakening any gates or introducing forbidden changes:

1. **`scripts/prepush_gates.sh` (Pre-push Quality Gates & Stamping)**:
   - Executes identical pre-push quality gates (`cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --all-features`) disconnected from SSH before pushing.
   - Strictly enforces clean working tree equal to HEAD via `tree_is_head()` checking `[ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)" ]`, refusing to stamp (rc 2) on tracked modifications or any untracked, non-ignored files.
   - On gate success, stamps the commit SHA in `$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/prepush-gates/<sha>`.
   - Implements `--check <sha>` (rc 0 if stamped, rc 1 if not), `--run-gates`, and `--self-test`.
   - `--self-test` comprehensive suite (13 test cases covering clean trees, unstamped commits, failing test refusal, untracked .rs / non-.rs files, ignored build artifacts, and full e2e git push hook integration with stubbed cargo calls) verified to pass cleanly (`measured`).

2. **`.githooks/pre-push` (Hook Ref Inspection)**:
   - Reads pushed refs from stdin (`<local ref> <local sha> <remote ref> <remote sha>`).
   - Correctly skips quality gates on branch deletion (`0000000000000000000000000000000000000000`).
   - Uses `scripts/prepush_gates.sh --check "$lsha"` to immediately pass stamped commits without long cargo runs inside the open SSH connection.
   - For unstamped commits, falls back to executing all three gates (`--run-gates` or inline fallback). No gates are removed or weakened.

3. **Carried Clippy Fixes (#438)**:
   - The 4-line redundant borrow cleanup across `examples/inference/streaming_token_generator.rs` and `examples/training/autograd_custom_ops/main.rs` is included and cargo clippy passes with 0 warnings/errors (`measured`).

4. **Script Quality & Linting**:
   - `bash -n` and `shellcheck -S error` pass with zero diagnostics (`measured`).
